integrity: An analytic proof is supplied, the exact rational verification is reproducible with standard Python, and no external independent audit or certification is claimed.
scientific_limitations: Exact two-parameter phase boundaries are for four voters with a central deterministic shock target.
The all-population asymptotic is at fixed finite population and fixed nonboundary shock count; it is not uniform in population size.
The baseline update samples with replacement as specified; other voter normalizations alter constants.
Strict local maxima are defined on the discrete count probability mass function; no assertion about histogram smoothing.
Historical priority remains subject to independent specialist literature review.
title: Four-voter trimodality thresholds and exact rare-shock profiles in a noisy voter chain
